Title: Generally available: Improved Syslog RFC compliance using the new Azure Monitor agent

Body.Content:
The latest version of Azure Monitor agent is now capable of collecting syslog events from these vendors, device types, and standard formats: 

  • Cisco Meraki, ASA, FTD
  • Sophos XG
  • Juniper Networks
  • Corelight Zeek
  • CipherTrust
  • NXLog
  • McAfee
  • CEF (Common Event Format)

If you have you been experiencing data loss/truncation issues when using the Azure Monitor agent for Linux to collect syslog events, please update to the latest version.

Learn more.
